questions.question: Some Pharisees asked Jesus why His disciples broke the tradition of the elders. What were the disciples not doing?

answers.text: Washing their hands before they ate
Fasting twice a week like others

questions.question: Jesus quoted Isaiah about people who honor God with their lips. Where did He say their hearts are?
Jesus told the crowd what really makes a man unclean. What did He say makes him unclean?

answers.text: What comes out of his mouth
